- `NullPointerException`: This exception is thrown if the specified element is null and the list does not permit null elements. The code does not check if `lt` is null before adding it to the list. `ArrayList` does not allow null elements by default, so this exception is not avoided.
- `IllegalArgumentException`: This exception is thrown if some property of the element prevents it from being added to the list. The code does not perform any specific checks on the properties of `lt` that might cause this exception, so this exception is not avoided.
